[RTIM.2.1] **A harness tests an ordinary engine.** It puts the engine under test with operations every integrator has: it takes the clock off
live before the first input ([NLFC.5.2]), registers the callbacks the program
under test needs — a mock is one of them ([RTIM.4.1.1]) — registers the stream
callback it observes through ([NCBK.2.1]), and loads the compiled program. The
engine holds no state that distinguishes a test from production.
